svg.text: FULL ADDER — Sum = A⊕B⊕Cin , Cout = A·B + Cin·(A⊕B)
FULL SUBTRACTOR (A − B − Bin) — Diff = A⊕B⊕Bin , Bout = A'·B + Bin·(A⊕B)'
● dot = wires joined. Wires that cross without a dot are NOT joined. NC = leave unconnected.
Power on BOTH chips: pin 14 → +5V, pin 7 → GND. Unused inputs → GND.
Inputs A, B, Cin/Bin: switch to +5V with 10 kΩ pull-down to GND. Outputs: pin → 330 Ω → LED → GND.
Build one circuit at a time (both together need a second 74HC86).
